articles.title: Chainlink launches new version of its crypto bridge tech 'CCIP' to give apps more control over their security
articles.snippet: The new software lets companies add custom security checks so they do not fall victim to the same type of vulnerabilities that plagued rival bridges.

articles.title: RedotPay completes financial audit as it presses ahead with U.S. IPO plans
articles.snippet: The stablecoin payments company said the audit is part of its preparations to go public, disputing an August report that the listing had been put on hold.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum’s shift beyond a blockchain in sweeping 2030 vision
articles.snippet: Buterin wants Ethereum to do far more work without forcing every computer on the network to repeat the same calculations.

articles.title: Blockchain.com eyes $500M IPO as crypto capital markets thaw: Report
articles.snippet: The crypto company is seeking a valuation of up to $6 billion, well below its 2022 peak, as recently listed crypto stocks struggle to hold their gains.

articles.title: Hong Kong regulators expand financial reporting oversight to licensed crypto firms
articles.snippet: The SFC and AFRC signed a new MoU extending financial reporting, audit and compliance cooperation to licensed virtual asset service providers.
